original_text.raw_value: General Procedure C. A solution of 7a (0.24 mmol) in absolute toluene (6.0 mL) was irradiated in a microwave reactor at 150 °C for 2 h with stirring while monitored by TLC; solvent was evaporated in vacuo and 8a was crystallized from Et2O.

addition_order.raw_value: A solution of the appropriate substrate in absolute toluene was placed in the microwave reactor.
